When I came to the Believers it's because I think the Mission is right. I may not know who I am (maybe one of the Chinese Emperors? That just feels right? items.source_en:
Trident Operations Manual SOTS-02-21.28

In the event of a ship-wide lockdown, the Purser on duty will lock their computer, and report to their mustering location on A Deck. Any passenger with a valid Claim ID will still be able to access their goods through the auto-retrieval system. Once the lockdown has been canceled, the Purser on duty will return to their normal posting and continue to assist passengers until port-of-call arrival.

In the event that the vessel has been attacked either internally or externally, the magnetic seal will be activated on the safe and access will be fully restricted. Any passenger with a valid Claim ID will have to wait until the ship's alert has been canceled to access their goods.

items.source_en:
We've been stuck in this room for days. There's so little oxygen in our tanks you can probably count the molecules on one hand.

But I've told the crew to ration slowly, and keep their heartbeats still. We'll try to stay alive as long as we can, in case another ship finds us.

It's important we stay calm, because the more we panic, the more oxygen we consume. I've asked each crew member to say some words to help distract us from the situation, but I think they misunderstood the assignment.

First Mate Szczerbiak used the moment to give me a eulogy, which started a trend where we each spoke on another's behalf. I reminded them, we still might live. All this talk of death and dying was not my intention. 

But at the same time, talking about each other reminds us what we're living for. So, I let it go.

승무원들에게는 천천히 쓰라고 했다. 심장박동을 늦추라고도 했다. 다른 함선이 우릴 발견할 경우에 대비해서, 할 수 있는 한 오래 버텨야 한다.

침착함을 잃지 않는 게 중요하다. 공황에 빠지면, 산소를 더 쓰게 될 테니까. 나는 이 상황에서 주의를 돌리려고 승무원들에게 같은 단어를 반복하도록 지시했다. 그런데 내 지시를 오해한 것 같다.

일등 항해사 저비악은 시간을 내서 내게 추도사를 주었다. 그러자 서로가 서로에게 추도사를 쓰는 게 유행처럼 번졌다. 나는 승무원들에게 우린 아직 살아남을 수 있다는 걸 얘기했다. 죽음에 대해 이야기하는 건 내 의도가 아니었건만.

그렇지만 한편으론, 서로에 대해 터놓고 얘기하는 게 지금껏 우리가 무엇을 위해 살아왔는가를 떠올리게 한다. 그러니, 그대로 두련다.
